column3: Open /mission?sample=1. You have never seen this app. Work out what the screen shows and what each control in the top two bars and the bottom bar does, tapping each once (Brainstorm, Product, Today, Week, Retro, play, LIVE). Say in your report, in two sentences, what the app is for. Report anything clipped, overlapping, unreadable, off screen or needing sideways scrolling.

Open /mission?sample=1. Tap Retro. Read the retro sheet from top to bottom, scrolling inside it. Tap the top-ranked time sink and check the matching chats are visible and highlighted on the canvas, not hidden under the sheet. Tap the folded sheet to reopen it, then tap Retro to close it. Report every step a phone user could not complete, find or understand.

Open /mission?sample=1. On this narrow phone tap Today, Week, Project and Custom in turn, and for Custom set both dates. After each tap check that the summary line under the buttons and the canvas changed sensibly, and that no control is clipped or needs sideways scrolling. Then tap Brainstorm and Product.

Open /mission?sample=1. Tap a chat card on the canvas to open its details. Read the details sheet, check the card you tapped is still visible above it, then close it with its close button. Tap play, then tap the replay strip at two different points, then tap LIVE. Report anything that did not respond, was hard to hit or hid what you needed.

Open /mission?sample=1. At desktop size switch Brainstorm and Product, Today and Week, open Retro and click a time sink, open a chat card and close its drawer, then press play and LIVE. Report anything broken, overlapping or unreadable.

Open /mission?sample=1. Tap Today, Week and Project in turn and check the summary under them changes. Tap Retro, read the retro sheet from top to bottom and tap the top time sink. Close Retro. Tap play and then LIVE in the bottom bar. Report every control that does nothing, is off screen or clipped, and any text too small to read.
